research.website_note: The official Linear homepage and download page on linear.app identify the website as Linear's own site.

strategy.observation: Linear supports AI agents that collaborate on complex tasks or handle entire issues end-to-end.
strategy.offer_link: Recruiting and scheduling interviews with customers who use or are evaluating these agents could help the Head of Product explore when teams want agent assistance versus end-to-end execution, without requiring the product team to coordinate participants.
hypotheses: Linear may be evaluating how customers decide which issues to delegate to AI agents.
The product team may benefit from interviewing customers with different levels of experience using agents.
Recruiting and scheduling those customers may take time away from conducting interviews and applying the findings.
strategy.angle: With Linear supporting agents that can handle entire issues end-to-end, would interviews with customers about what they would—and wouldn't—delegate be useful for your product decisions?
strategy.fit_reason: The offer provides a plausible way to gather customer input on an explicitly supported product capability, and the Head of Product is a relevant recipient; Linear's current research needs and recruitment capacity are unconfirmed.

draft.subject: Customer interviews on agent delegation
draft.body:
If you're exploring where customers draw the line on handing entire issues to AI agents, interviews could help clarify when they want assistance versus full delegation.

I recruit and schedule customer interview participants for product teams. Here, that would mean recruiting customers who use or are evaluating agents, leaving your team to conduct the interviews rather than coordinate participants.

Would you start with customers already delegating whole issues, or those still deciding what to hand over?
